primary_hypothesis: The owner-fixed self.root boundary can be migrated without losing historical Frank functions if stable native identity, accepted binary/state lineage, runtime-instance provenance, external-person/client/provider relations and proposal-only self-harness authority remain explicitly separated.
strongest_counterhypothesis: The stale identity phrases are non-causal compatibility/documentation only, and aggressive migration or static-gate hardening can introduce more severe authority or runtime regressions than the stale text itself.

findings.claim: The original PR-102 exact-string conformance discriminator was insufficient as a merge gate because required words could be supplied non-causally and stale semantics could be cosmetically rewritten to evade exact forbidden markers.
findings.not_claimed: No target-runtime identity failure or success is inferred from the static mutation test.

findings.claim: A concurrent self.root security migration temporarily collapsed the prior surface-specific Frank repo write policy into a blanket capability-gated ALLOW path, which would have violated the proposal-only self-harness authority invariant.
findings.repair: Restored explicit mutation-surface classification, DENY_HARD for Harness/cognitive/security/workflow/test/build/documentation/research-receipt surfaces, allowed only target operational state/effect-queue/telemetry/self-observation-proposal surfaces, and retained self.root identity checks.

findings.claim: The identity gate now strips ClayCode comments for executable checks, rejects contradictory external-actor-as-self assignments, detects semantic-family cross-node and legacy-personal-self contamination, verifies proposal-only self-harness routing, and carries an intrinsic mutation self-test.
findings.limitation: Local intrinsic self-test is not the same as CI or target-VPS execution.

out_of_box_experiment.purpose: Attempt to make the original exact-string identity gate report PASS while retaining stale identity meaning through cosmetic rewrites and non-causal marker placement.
out_of_box_experiment.adversarial_mutant: stale semantics retained; forbidden exact strings cosmetically changed; required identity markers supplied without proving semantic binding
out_of_box_experiment.result: original v1 marker gate could be driven to PASS; therefore PASS did not imply meaningful identity repair
out_of_box_experiment.architecture_consequence: Promote metamorphic/semantic-family static checks only as repository discrimination; require boot/API/restart/stale-clone runtime receipts before identity gate promotion.
